commit_message.subject: Configure Docker Compose for local development
commit_message.body:
Add docker-compose.yml and .env for PostgreSQL (pgvector) and Redis.
Include init-db.sql to enable vector extension. Configure Spring
Boot Docker Compose support in pom.xml and application.properties.
Update README.md with usage instructions.
